headline: 英倫劇場文化速報
context: 伯明罕輪演劇院重新搬演桑坦（Stephen Sondheim）經典音樂劇《理髮師陶德》（Sweeney Todd），演出至 8 月 15 日。麥克斯·波特（Max Porter）的小說《Grief Is the Thing With Feathers》推出有聲書版本，由演員羅素·托維（Russell Tovey）朗讀。好萊塢圈也吹起「星二代爸爸」風潮，柯瑞·巴克（Curry Barker）的父親即將自己執導新片。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Birmingham Rep With tremendous singing from Ramin Karimloo and Meow Meow, Joe Murphy’s superb staging of the story is full of dark gothic humour Stephen Sondheim was drawn to fairytales – and not just in the storybook theme of Into the Woods . The origins of Sweeney Todd, the demon barber of Fleet Street, lie in Victorian melodrama, but in the hands of the composer, working with book writer Hugh Wheeler in response to a play by Christopher Bond, it is steeped in the tropes of folklore. The story of a serial killer who provides the grisly contents for his landlady’s pies is ripe with the kind of dark gothic humour that appealed to the Brothers Grimm. There are shades of Hansel and Gretel in the cavernous oven and of Little Red Riding Hood in the prospect of being turned into someone’s dinner. The composer’s lyrics even quote the nursery rhyme Pat-a-Cake, Pat-a-Cake, Baker’s Man. At Birmingham Rep until 15 August Continue reading...
sources.title: Sweeney Todd review – Sondheim’s demon barber is still a cut above

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Actor Russell Tovey’s narration crackles with compassion and menace in this magical story of a widower and his young sons in mourning Less than a week after the sudden death of his wife, a grieving man opens his front door to a giant crow who scoops him up into his wing and tells him: “I won’t leave until you don’t need me anymore.” Still in shock, the man is facing the prospect of raising his two young sons alone. The bird, which has previously been roaming around the family’s flat at night, has observed a household of “heavy mourning, every surface dead Mum, every crayon, tractor, coat, welly covered in a film of grief”. In that first visit, the man “woke up and didn’t see me against the blackness of his trauma”. First published in 2015 and since adapted as a play and film, Grief Is the Thing With Feathers is an inventive and sharply observed novella by Max Porter which uses verse, dialogue and the supernatural to examine a family grappling with the loss of a wife and mother who had been “busy living, and then she was gone”. In a story that shifts between the perspectives of “Dad”, “Boys” and “Crow”, we learn the man is a writer who is working on a book about the poet Ted Hughes called Crow on the Couch. Continue reading...

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: With Dane Cook set to star in his new film, Curry Barker’s dad joins Lana Del Rey’s dad and Tom Holland’s dad in a new wave of nepo daddies A generational shift is happening in Hollywood. The two big breakout films of the spring – Backrooms and Obsession – were made by a pair of plucky young YouTubers who found themselves granted the keys to the kingdom . Both of these films took more money than the most recent Star Wars , the most recent superhero movie ( Supergirl ) and the most recent Spielberg . It is arguably the biggest shake-up of the film industry since the rise of New Hollywood in the 1970s. But perhaps the biggest change is tangential to all of this. This week it was announced that Jeff Barker – the father of Obsession direction Curry Barker – is making a film of his own. Medium Rare is a horror short that will shoot this summer and star Dane Cook and the Oscar-nominated actor Lesley Ann Warren. This will come hot on the heels of Good Tape, another horror short of Barker’s that is currently in post-production. Continue reading...

thread_text:
英國劇場文化這邊有幾件事。伯明罕輪演劇院重新搬演桑坦（Stephen Sondheim）的經典音樂劇《理髮師陶德》（Sweeney Todd），卡里姆盧（Ramin Karimloo）和喵喵（Meow Meow）的演唱獲得好評，演出至 8 月 15 日。麥克斯·波特（Max Porter）的小說《Grief Is the Thing With Feathers》推出有聲書版本，由演員羅素·托維（Russell Tovey）朗讀，評論形容這個版本兼具溫柔與陰森。好萊塢也吹起一股「星二代爸爸」風潮——執導《Obsession》的年輕導演柯瑞·巴克（Curry Barker），他的父親傑夫·巴克（Jeff Barker）這次也要自己執導一部恐怖短片。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 17 日的報導。
threads_text:
英國劇場文化這邊有幾件事。伯明罕輪演劇院重新搬演桑坦（Stephen Sondheim）的經典音樂劇《理髮師陶德》（Sweeney Todd），卡里姆盧（Ramin Karimloo）和喵喵（Meow Meow）的演唱撐起全場，導演喬·墨菲（Joe Murphy）的舞台呈現充滿黑色哥德幽默，演出至 8 月 15 日。麥克斯·波特（Max Porter）2015 年出版的小說《Grief Is the Thing With Feathers》，這次推出有聲書版本，由演員羅素·托維（Russell Tovey）朗讀，評論形容他的演繹兼具溫柔與陰森，把一段喪妻之痛的故事說得動人。好萊塢圈子也吹起一股「星二代爸爸」的風潮——執導賣座恐怖片《Obsession》的年輕導演柯瑞·巴克（Curry Barker），他的父親傑夫·巴克（Jeff Barker）這次也要自己執導一部恐怖短片，將由丹·庫克（Dane Cook）主演。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 17 日的報導。
voice_text: 英國劇場文化這邊有幾件事。伯明罕重新搬演桑坦的經典音樂劇《理髮師陶德》，兩位主唱的表現撐起全場，充滿黑色哥德式的幽默，演到八月中。麥克斯·波特那本以烏鴉陪伴喪妻之痛聞名的小說，這次出了有聲書版本，朗讀兼具溫柔與陰森，把故事說得動人。好萊塢那邊也吹起一股「星二代爸爸」風潮，拍出賣座恐怖片的年輕導演，這次換他爸爸自己下海執導了。
